title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-safety-improvements
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add stability gates and configurable safety thresholds to unified rollouts auto-rollback workflow; improved rollback observability and added e2e + unit tests.
description:
Context: Our unified rollouts engine supports canary, A/B and shadow traffic with automated rollback policies. Over the last quarter we've observed two classes of failures: (1) noisy signals from transient infra flakiness causing unwanted rollbacks during heavy load, and (2) lack of visibility into which metric contributed to a rollback, which makes postmortems slow. This PR introduces safety guards and observability improvements to reduce false-positive rollbacks and speed diagnosis.

Summary of changes: 1) Add a stability gate that requires a metric quorum across multiple windows before triggering an automatic rollback; 2) Introduce per-metric weight and hysteresis config for composite rollback evaluation; 3) Emit detailed rollback_decision telemetry (reason, metric snapshots, windowed deltas) to tracing/metrics; 4) Add e2e tests that simulate transient infra errors and ensure guard prevents noisy rollbacks; 5) Small refactor of the autorollback engine to make gate evaluation pluggable.

Why: Reduce customer-facing flaps due to premature rollbacks, improve MTTR by making rollback signals explicit, and provide safe defaults that can be tuned per-tenant.

Notable design notes: - Quorum semantics: by default require >=2 of 3 consecutive evaluation windows to exceed thresholds before auto-rollback; configurable via rollout config (sensible defaults applied). - Weighted metrics: teams can specify weights for latency/error/quality metrics; the composite score uses weights + hysteresis to avoid oscillation. - Observability: rollback_decision events include top-3 contributing metrics + raw window values to allow root-cause analysis.

Checklist: [x] Unit tests for gate logic, [x] Integration tests for telemetry emission, [x] E2E sim tests for transient failures, [x] Docs (rollout config reference and migration guide), [x] Backwards compatible defaults.

Notes: This is a safety-forward change; default behavior is conservative and should not change existing rollouts unless customers opt into the new quorum/weights via rollout config. Migration guide included in docs/rollouts/README.md.

Related: ENG-3572 (quorum gate), ENG-3625 (observability for rollback), SUP-7890 (customer incident for noisy rollback).

changed_files:
High-level changed files: 
- services/rollouts/autorollback/engine.py (add pluggable gate interface, ~150 LOC added)
- services/rollouts/autorollback/quorum_gate.py (new, ~120 LOC) 
- services/rollouts/autorollback/weighted_metric.py (new helper for composite scoring)
- services/telemetry/events/rollback_decision.v1.json (schema + instrumentation)
- tests/unit/test_quorum_gate.py (new unit tests)
- tests/e2e/sim/transient_infra_rollback_guard.test (new e2e sim)
- docs/rollouts/README.md (migration + config examples)
- infra/packaging/rollouts_dev_config.yaml (default gate config updated)

Small snippet from engine.py (illustrative):
- before: trigger_auto_rollback(metrics) -> boolean
- after: decision = gate_evaluator.evaluate(metrics, windows=3); if decision.action == 'rollback': emit(rollback_decision=decision)

No large diffs; major logic encapsulated in new gate module so existing code paths remain stable.

notes:
Backward compatibility: defaults are conservative; customers not opting in will see no behavior change. Observability: rollback_decision events are indexed and low-cardinality keys chosen to avoid high-cost telemetry for small customers. Follow-ups: add UI flag in console + an advanced config guide.

Changelog entry: safety: autorollback now uses quorum gate to prevent noisy rollbacks; improved rollback telemetry (rollback_decision events).
